select temp.* from(
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS03}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, null actPortfolioId, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName,
T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, T1.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, T1.VDATE, T1.MDATE, T3.THEORY_PRIN prinAmt,
T1.SETTLE_DATE settleDate,
T3.THEORY_INT intAmt,
T3.THEORY_AMT theoryAmt,
T1.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, T1.WORKFLOW_ID workflowId, null pTradeId FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_PA_TRD_FIN_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID and t1.BRANCH = t4.BRANCH WHERE T1.BUSI_TYPE = #{COMMON_BUSINESS_TYPETRD11} and T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01}
ORDER BY T1.TRADE_DATE DESC )
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS01}' statusValid, T1.TRADE_ID busiCode, T3.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, null actPortfolioId, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, T1.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, T4.VDATE, T4.MDATE,
T1.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, null settleDate, T4.M_INT_AMT intAmt, T1.PRIN_AMT+T4.M_INT_AMT theoryAmt, null tradeAmt, null workflowId, null pTradeId FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID and t1.BRANCH = t4.BRANCH WHERE T2.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' and T1.BUSI_TYPE = #{COM_TYPE_TRD03} and t1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} and t1.IS_CANCEL != #{YES_OR_NO_Y}
and T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 in (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF08},#{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF09},#{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF25}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.PS=#{PS_HBDZ} and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} and TPD.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID ) and T2.PORTFOLIO_ID
AND (instr(T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, #{busiCode}) > 0)
AND ( (T2.PORTFOLIO_ID in
null) or T2.PORTFOLIO_ID in (
#{item} ) OR (T2.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID in
null) or T2.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID in (
#{item}
))
AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF09}
AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 in (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF08},#{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF25})
AND T1.TRADE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDateStart}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND T1.TRADE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
ORDER BY T1.TRADE_DATE DESC )
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS05}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID actPortfolioId, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, T1.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, T1.VDATE, T1.MDATE, T3.THEORY_PRIN theoryPrin, T1.SETTLE_DATE settleDate,
T3.THEORY_INT theoryInt,
T3.THEORY_AMT theoryAmt,
T1.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, null workflowId, null pTradeId FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID and t1.BRANCH = t4.BRANCH LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON T1.FINPROD_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE T1.BUSI_TYPE = #{COMMON_BUSINESS_TYPETRD11} and t1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} and t1.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} AND PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y'
ORDER BY T1.TRADE_DATE DESC )
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS06}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID actPortfolioId, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, T1.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, T1.VDATE, T1.MDATE, T3.THEORY_PRIN theoryPrin, T1.SETTLE_DATE settleDate,
T3.THEORY_INT theoryInt,
T3.THEORY_AMT theoryAmt,
T1.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, null workflowId, T1.P_TRADE_ID pTradeId FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID and t1.BRANCH = t4.BRANCH LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON T1.FINPROD_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND T1.BUSI_TYPE = #{COMMON_BUSINESS_TYPETRD11} and t1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} and t1.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N}
ORDER BY T1.TRADE_DATE DESC )
)temp
